eps.t: The Crew Builds a Halloween Maze
eps.o: The crew builds a spooky maze for Halloween; when Omar and Romar get lost in the maze, the pups jump to the rescue.

eps.t: The Crew Builds a Giant Pup House
eps.o: When a spooky movie keeps Rubble awake, the pups come up with a construction solution.

eps.t: The Crew Builds a North Pole Village for Santa
eps.o: Santa's coming to visit Builder Cove! But when Speed Meister tricks him into stopping at the wrong place, Rubble & Crew have to save Santa.

eps.t: The Crew Builds a Giant Dreidel
eps.o: Rubble & Crew make Builder Cove's big Hanukkah celebration even bigger by building an awesome giant dreidel.

eps.t: The Crew Builds a Giant Duck Plane
eps.o: A flock of migrating ducks settles in Builder Cove! It's up to Rubble & Crew to help the ducks start moving south.

eps.t: The Crew Builds a Special Vet Room for Motor
eps.o: Motor doesn't want to visit Dr. Diwa at the Vet Clinic so the pups build a special space just for her!

eps.t: The Crew Builds an Art Museum
eps.o: Rubble & Crew build the perfect place to show off River's ever-changing photography projects... Builder Cove's own art museum!

eps.t: The Crew Builds a Giant Alphorn
eps.o: Farmer Zoe has a new goat on her farm! But when she can't find the singing goat, the pups team up with Park Ranger Rose.

eps.t: The Crew Builds a Fancy Drive-Thru Restaurant
eps.o: When Camila the truck driver needs a place to stop and eat, the pups and Café Carl have a fancy idea. But is it too fancy?

eps.t: The Crew Builds a Castle Show
eps.o: Park Ranger Rose and Rosie the goat are putting on a show! But when Rosie disappears, can the pups find her before showtime?

eps.t: The Crew Builds a Pirate Ship Café
eps.o: When Café Carl's pirate-themed restaurant gets caught in rough waters, the pups set sail with a new construction solution.

eps.t: The Crew Builds a Sierra Sparkle Experience
eps.o: Sierra Sparkle calls in help from Rubble & Crew to build a special experience for all her fans in Builder Cove.
